+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import os
+
+from .utils import format_filename
+
+
+def file_diagnostics(
+    paths: cabc.Iterable[str | bytes | os.PathLike[str] | os.PathLike[bytes]],
+    shorten: bool = False,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Build a "Cannot open" diagnostic message for each path, in order.
+
+    Each path is formatted for display with :func:`format_filename`, so
+    undecodable bytes and surrogate escapes are replaced with ``�``
+    instead of raising a :exc:`UnicodeError`. The files are not opened.
+
+    :param paths: The paths to describe. May be ``str``, ``bytes``, or
+        path-like objects.
+    :param shorten: Show only the base name of each path.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 8.2.2
+    """
+    return [f"Cannot open: {format_filename(path, shorten=shorten)}" for path in paths]

+import pathlib
+
+import pytest
+
+from click.file_diagnostics import file_diagnostics
+
+
+def test_empty():
+    assert file_diagnostics([]) == []
+    assert file_diagnostics(iter(())) == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("path", "expect"),
+    [
+        ("/x/foo.txt", "/x/foo.txt"),
+        (b"/x/foo.txt", "/x/foo.txt"),
+        (pathlib.Path("x", "foo.txt"), str(pathlib.Path("x", "foo.txt"))),
+        (pathlib.PurePosixPath("/x/foo.txt"), "/x/foo.txt"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_path_types(path, expect):
+    assert file_diagnostics([path]) == [f"Cannot open: {expect}"]
+
+
+def test_shorten():
+    paths = ["/x/foo.txt", b"/y/bar.txt", pathlib.PurePosixPath("/z/baz.txt")]
+    assert file_diagnostics(paths, shorten=True) == [
+        "Cannot open: foo.txt",
+        "Cannot open: bar.txt",
+        "Cannot open: baz.txt",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_preserves_order():
+    paths = ["c", "a", "b", "a"]
+    assert file_diagnostics(paths) == [f"Cannot open: {p}" for p in paths]
+
+
+def test_invalid_bytes():
+    (message,) = file_diagnostics([b"/x/\xff.txt"])
+    assert message.startswith("Cannot open: /x/")
+    assert message.endswith(".txt")
+    message.encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def test_surrogate_escape():
+    path = b"/x/\xff.txt".decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
+    assert file_diagnostics([path]) == ["Cannot open: /x/\ufffd.txt"]
+    assert file_diagnostics([path], shorten=True) == ["Cannot open: \ufffd.txt"]
+
+
+def test_does_not_open(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    missing = tmp_path / "missing.txt"
+
+    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError("file was opened")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("builtins.open", fail)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("os.open", fail)
+    assert file_diagnostics([missing]) == [f"Cannot open: {missing}"]
+    assert not missing.exists()
